title: 第478章 一丈之差第477章 气血盖世
slug: 签到大帝修为开局收下禁忌剑体
content_zh:
轰！
犹如亿万落雷齐齐在脑海中爆发！
岸上众人全都目瞪口呆！
那滔天的赤霞，遮天蔽日，淹没亿万里山河，席卷八荒六合，映照出一片赤红的苍穹！
“天啊！这......这是什么？”
“一身磅礴的气血雄如汪洋？！！”
“他是怎么做到的？”
无数生灵倒吸一口凉气，在惊颤，内心震动剧烈，满脸的不可思议！
“他真的是人族吗？不论是我们妖族还是其他擅长肉身的种族，都在逍遥境做不到如此地步吧？”
一名妖族修士瞳孔剧烈收缩，死死地盯着那道愈发神秘莫测的身影。
他浑身汗毛倒竖，内心情绪波涛汹涌，莫名地感到一股荒诞，但更多的是一阵又一阵的冰寒！
那是一种对于未知、对于神秘的畏惧！
众所周知，在同境之中，人族肉身普遍弱于妖兽一族，除非有着特殊的肉身体质或者如申屠狂那般修炼炼体之术。
可眼前此人......
简直超越了常理！
远远地超越！
然而，更恐怖的是。
“这股气息......逍遥境五重天？”
一名修士似乎感知到了什么，睁大眸子，眼珠都快要突出来。
“不！这怎么可能？”

“他怎么才逍遥境五重天？”
“他究竟是谁？到底是什么来历？”
“他该不会来自人道学院吧？”
“我也曾有幸去人道学院进修过，但从未听说过此人......”
轰！
随着凌川战力全开，荡漾出真实境界气息。
岸上众人再次炸开了锅，惊呼声一阵又一阵，犹如山呼海啸！
“这就是传说中的......不灭圣体？”
玄冰层之上，申屠狂脚步蓦然顿住，他的胸口剧烈起伏，脑海中轰鸣不止，神色一时难以平静。
那茫茫无边的滔天血气让他感到一丝迷茫。
怎会有这么恐怖的肉身体质？
不灭圣体是否过于强大了？
对于不灭圣体他其实也了解不多，只从族中一本残破的古籍上看到过少许相关记载。
忽然，他神色再次大变，一双深邃的眸子中溅射出惊人的光芒！
“你才逍遥境五重天？”
申屠狂清晰地感知到凌川散发的境界气息。
猛然间，他感受到一股巨大的压力，神色异常凝重。
content_en:
boom!
It's like billions of thunders all bursting out in my mind!
Everyone on the shore was stunned!
The monstrous crimson cloud covered the sky and the sun, submerged hundreds of millions of miles of mountains and rivers, swept across the world, and reflected a red sky!
"Oh my god! What...what is this?"
"A body of majestic Qi and blood as majestic as the ocean?!!"
"How did he do it?"
Countless creatures took a breath of cold air, trembled, their hearts shook violently, and their faces were full of disbelief!
"Is he really a human race? Neither our demon race nor other races that are good at the physical body can do this in Xiaoyao Realm, right?"
A demon monk's pupils shrank violently, staring at the increasingly mysterious figure.
The hair on his body stood on end, and his inner emotions were turbulent. He felt an inexplicable sense of absurdity, but more importantly, he felt cold one after another!
That is a kind of fear of the unknown and the mystery!
As we all know, in the same realm, the human body is generally weaker than the monster beast family, unless they have a special physical constitution or practice body refining techniques like Shen Tu Kuang.
But this person in front of me...
It’s simply beyond common sense!
Far beyond!
However, what's even scarier is.
"This aura... the fifth level of Xiaoyao Realm?"
A monk seemed to sense something and opened his eyes so wide that they almost popped out.
"No! How is this possible?"
"How come he is in the fifth level of Xiaoyao Realm?"
"Who is he? What is his origin?"
"Could he be from the Humane College?"
"I have also had the privilege of going to the Humane College for further study, but I have never heard of this person..."
Boom!
With Lingchuan's combat power at full strength, the aura of the true realm rippled out.
Everyone on the shore exploded again, screaming one after another, like a mountain roaring and a tsunami!
"Is this the legendary... Immortal Holy Body?"
On top of the black ice layer, Shentu Kuang's footsteps suddenly stopped, his chest heaved violently, his mind was roaring, and his expression could not be calm for a moment.
The boundless blood energy made him feel a little confused.
How could he have such a terrifying physical body?
Is the Immortal Holy Body too powerful?
He actually didn't know much about the Immortal Holy Body. He only read a few relevant records from a broken ancient book in the clan.
Suddenly, his expression changed drastically again, and an astonishing light burst out from his deep eyes!
"Are you only at the fifth level of Xiaoyao Realm?"
Shentu Kuang clearly sensed the realm aura emanating from Lingchuan.
Suddenly, he felt a huge pressure and his expression was extremely solemn.
